title: best smart watch to use as collector?
body:
sorry this isnt an issue, i just couldnt see anywhere this is mentioned.

what is the best smartwatch to use as a collector when phone is out of range? thanks

comments.body:
What sensor?
should the watch have a sim?
libre blucon/miaomiao "getting mm soon" sim doesnt matter i just connect via bluetooth

I am using Finowatch Q1 PRO

https://www.deebee.it/?p=15216
Is there any setting on the Finow to switch on the display with a move of the arm?
There is an option: To Rotate de screen automatically .
will try it! Thx!!
OK, the display is rotating. Fine. But when the screen goes OFF it is not going on when I move my arm. This is what I want to have like on an OS wear watch.
I know and I also would like to wake up the screen with two touchs on the screen but I can't :(
i have the gear s2 gear s3 frontier, then noticed tizen doesnt work as a collector so got a lg watch sport but doesnt seem to connect :(

To use a watch as a collector, see the wiki here:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Patching-Android-Wear-devices-for-use-with-the-G5

The only watch to work as a collector " out of the box" is the SSW3. The others must be tweaked.

Does anybody have the Zeblaze Thor 4 also know as Lemfo LEM7? It looks pretty nice and have decent power consumption and runs on native Android 7.
For comparison:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1172f1b4ZdGBI6L34fkfgE06pOHyZAZrxmb3APFlhewQ/edit#gid=0
If anyone is using the Q1 Pro please help me with any information about current issues here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/648 thanks

Has anyone got an updated 2019 working list?
I am also looking at the Zeblaze Thor 4 for collector. 
Also having a hard time finding the minimum requirements for a android collector watch.

Thanks
I use a Zeblaze Thor 4 as collector watch. But the UI is not good on round smartwatches...

I am interested in the Zeblaze Thor 4, but cannot seem to find any info on how to modify the rom (carepack?) in order to make sure that I will actually be Able to use it as a collector! (g5 non native)
Could someone please post a link to that info here?
You don't need anything to change, it is a native Android Smartwatch, so no ROM Changing is needed. This is only needed for Android Wear / Google Wear Smartwatches!

It would be great if Xdrip or android smartwatches had the possibility of screen zoom. For example Finow Q1 has it.
My smartwatch,Kospet Optimus pro, do not have it in android menu (settings->accessibilities->magnification).
I don't know if other watches have it.

Hi everyone. I am using a sony smartwatch 3 with a Nokia phone and miao miao - all working splendidly. Whilst the watch can work as a collector, I don't know if its possible for the watch to upload directly to nightscout via wifi without the phone? Or if there are any 3/4g watches that do this?

Basically looking for a phoneless solution for my 10 year old daughter

@Mr-Enigma A good place to ask about and share ideas and knowledge and experience with xDrip and watches is the xDrip facebook group.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
or the Gitter room.
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus

Would you please close this issue?
There is also a [Watch Guide](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md).
Closing due to inactivity
